steps.content:
15:25, August 10, N.F. 113
Eastside, Banyan Medical College,
First Affiliated Hospital,
Special Ward.

Christina doesn't remember how long she cried for. It's been so long since she's seen Shalom, her tears just flow. In the distant future, when she thinks back on this event, she feels a little embarrassed.
But now, the future great detective faces another serious trial.

Shalom sits by the hospital bed, slowly peeling an apple. She's not skilled with the knife, her movements are slow, but precise enough. Under the gaze of the Schorl, the thin apple skin extends bit by bit before falling, and she finally speaks.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I heard that you frequently used your abilities during the investigation and almost lost control.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: I... I was forced by circumstances...

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I think we agreed that the premise of giving you this task was not to rely on violence, to control your own Mania. Pursue truth and justice with wisdom. Right? We agreed, didn't we?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Yes, yes, of course I'll do it! I will do my best to complete the mission that you gave me.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Ah... ha... I-I remember, it's just that the enemies were too strong...
She had long forgotten.
Click.

With a soft sound, the apple skin in Shalom's hand peels away. She carves a crescent shape with the knife, skewers it with a toothpick, and offers a gentle smile as she feeds it to Christina. She waits anxiously, sweat pouring profusely.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Here, open your mouth.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: It seems I'm pushing you too hard. Should we switch to a more suitable task?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Wahhh! N-no, Shalom. I made a mistake! I won't misuse my abilities again! Don't leave me—
The crying that had finally stopped once again echoes through the ward.
Five minutes later.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Have you finished your work?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Where's Rahu? I remember she saved me last night, from all those monsters... is she alright?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Rahu said, "I didn't even need to use my abilities to deal with those things." You see?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: She's already searching for the Garden's base near the scene of the incident. Your near-death experience provided vital information, we will treasure it.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: As for work... we need a bit more time. FAC will soon face an important battle, they need me to weigh in.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Oh... then I shouldn't bother you anymore...
Shalom smiles, and hands over a piece of apple.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Your task is also important. Tell me about your progress, I know you've made achievements.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Mmm!
She pulls up the investigation records, files, and reports all of her speculations.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: The Garden took on the commissions of vengeance, but why select these assignments? And the final combination should have a deeper meaning. Now it seems that they so generously gave me clues to guide my investigation.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: The first two cases are related to FAC's defeat in N.F. 103, without a doubt, that must be the reason.
When talking about ten years ago, Christina still feels a bit apprehensive.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Does the Garden think that what happened back then was unfair, and wants to attract attention through these cases, reveal the truth, and then make accusations?
Shalom picks up the second apple, still peeling it very slowly.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: They don't care about the public's opinion, after all, they are a group of people who want to keep vengeance firmly in their own hands.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Rehashing the events of N.F. 103, can only mean it's useful "now."

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: The Eclipse Operation was top secret, FAC made huge sacrifices for a greater cause, but this sacrifice was used and twisted by others.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Information leaked, the public's criticism of FAC was constant. Other factions in Eastside also took the opportunity to suppress. FAC lost its original status, and from then on was controlled by others. People's trust in the city-state fell to the bottom.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Like you, it was this very event that led you to believe there was a vast conspiracy behind the Nirvana incident in N.F. 104, prompting such a drastic assault.
Chris' head sinks.
It's true. In N.F. 103, Chris, who had lost her father and friends, also fell into paranoia. The next year when she heard about the Nirvana mine incident, she took drastic action.
The victim of that time is right in front of her.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: FAC will soon have a major battle in the West District. A very important Black Ring control operation, using a lot of manpower and funds, will cause the power structure to change. The most critical thing for the FAC Commander-in-Chief is to return to Eastside and push through the operation plan.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: So, rehashing the old events at this time, what do you think it's for?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Could it be that they want to stir up trouble again, trip up FAC's rear, and obstruct this operation?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: At least this is absolutely beneficial for the Underground. The Garden was originally an assassin group established by the Underground forces. Although they declared independence a few years ago, looking at the Erica Villa incident, they are still connected.
Thinking of the appearance of those people, Christina falls silent again.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Although her methods are outrageous, after actually meeting her, I don't think she's a complete lunatic.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: They are... a group of people who have already given up on this world. They don't believe in justice anymore, but they won't admit defeat either. They want to seize everything with their own hands.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: They're a lot like me in the past...

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: That's not true.
Setting down the fruit in her hand, she looks at Christina.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: If I was killed one day, would you kill for me?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: I won't let that happen!

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: But if it does happen, what will you do?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: I—I... I would find out the truth, capture the criminal, and prevent him from hurting anyone else. I won't let anyone end up like me...
Chris' head sinks more and more as she speaks, her words seeming less convincing even to herself.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: ...I don't want that. If I had to choose, I'd rather die than have you killed, Shalom. You're the most important person to me.
Shalom looks at the ginger girl with her head lowered. After a long pause, she said, word by word...

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: What if I committed crimes and evil deeds?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: No way! You would never do such a thing!

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Wrong answer. You should still seek the truth, capture the criminal, and prevent her from hurting anyone else. You're a detective, after all.
As she speaks, she ruffles Chris' hair, her voice regaining its usual warmth.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: I... I know... but you wouldn't do that.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Don't joke about that, it's too cruel...
Shalom looks at her, smiles, and pats her head.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Alright, alright, it's my fault for teasing you. I will always cherish your feelings.
The phone rings. Shalom answers it on speaker in front of Chris, continuing to peel the last apple with both hands.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: It's me. We've searched a 10-kilometer radius around where Christina appeared, but we haven't found the entrance to the Garden.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I suspect they deliberately moved Chris.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: They might have used some special technology, after all, they have the <color=#fb9259>Underground</color> backing them.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: According to Chris' investigation, there will soon be a response from the FAC. It's time to move.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I'll come pick you up.
The call ends. Shalom has finished peeling the apple, displaying a mastery gained from practice. She quickly cuts a piece and offers it to Christina.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I'll go first then. Contact me as soon as there's any progress with the case. Its nature has completely changed now, and I need you to provide more clues.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: I will! I'm heading out too! Since it's related to the battle, we can't delay.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: There must be clues in the third and fourth lines of the poem. Along with the events related to FAC in N.F. 103, at least I can issue a warning in advance and gather more information.
Christina jumps off the bed, grimacing but managing not to cry out in pain. She quickly changes her clothes.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: There's no need to rush, someone came to see you.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Huh?
The door opens, and a gloomy girl in a wheelchair stops at the entrance, eyeing the two people in the room warily.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Mireya?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Oh right, Shalom, Mireya is my sister. She's... a very smart kid!

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I know. She's a child from your foster family, you often mention her. You two must be very close.

steps.speaker: Mireya
steps.content: Tsk.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I'll leave you two alone. Take your time.
Christina nods repeatedly, bidding farewell to Shalom. When she turns back to look at Mireya, there's a hint of awkwardness.

steps.speaker: Mireya
steps.content: They said you were going to die and asked me to sign. But you're still alive.

steps.speaker: Mireya
steps.content: When you're ready to die for your justice, let me know in advance. Don't cause me any trouble.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: ...Don't say that. After I solve this case, can we sit down and talk?
Mireya doesn't respond, just watching Shalom leave.

steps.speaker: Mireya
steps.content: ...Is that the amazing person you mentioned?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Yes! She's really special, kind, just, and strong. She's also very smart, and her answers are always right!

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Thanks to her, I've regained my energy.

steps.speaker: Mireya
steps.content: ...That woman never looked at me directly. In her eyes, I'm invisible.

steps.speaker: Mireya
steps.content: You better be careful, or you won't know how you died.
Nasha

Now that they know that the murderer is targeting the chain reaction caused by the failed Eclipse Operation in N.F. 103, the direction hinted from the third and fourth lines of the poem becomes more obvious.
On the same night, she and Detective Dole work all night to identify several related businesses and individuals, contacting and warning each one.

Some people on the list panic and seek protection, while others deny everything. The investigation team follows up on each one. As Shalom said, the importance of the case has escalated and preventive strategy is needed.
However, Christina has a hunch that what's supposed to happen will inevitably happen...
